settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: As we make items fresh, we deliver them frozen within 24–48 hours.

settings.question: Is delivery free?
settings.answer: Yes — delivery is free on all orders above Rs. 2500.

settings.question: Are your products halal?
settings.answer: Yes. Every ingredient we use is 100% halal certified.

settings.question: How do I cook them?
settings.answer: Cook straight from frozen — deep-fry, air-fry or bake. Cooking instructions are on every pack and most snacks are ready in under 10 minutes.

settings.question: Do I have to pay in advance?
settings.answer: No, cash on delivery is available. If you pay in advance, your payment is secure and refundable in case of any issues.

settings.question: Can I return an order?
settings.answer: Yes. In case of any issue, unopened food items can be returned.
